description: This file defines two asynchronous functions, getSessionDurations and getCosts, which perform data aggregation and analysis on session tracking and cost data stored in MongoDB collections. It requires models for session tracking and LLM costs, and exports these functions for use elsewhere in the project.

methods.name: getSessionDurations
methods.description: Calculates total session duration in minutes and provides breakdowns grouped by user and project, based on session data.

methods.name: getCosts
methods.description: Calculates total costs and provides breakdowns grouped by user and project, based on cost data.
